scenes.title: The six strings
scenes.subtitle: String numbers and their names.
lines: In this lesson, you'll learn the names and numbers of the six strings on your guitar.

scenes.heading: Meet the strings
lines: Meet your guitar's six strings: 6 is the thickest and closest to your face, 1 the thinnest.
In standard tuning, they're E, A, D, G, B, E.
Use the memory trick 'Eddie Ate Dynamite, Good Bye Eddie' to remember the order from 6 to 1.
You're doing great — take your time to explore each string and let the music begin.

scenes.heading: How to pluck
points: Use thumb alone for softer sound
lines: Hold the pick between your thumb and the side of your index finger, showing only the tip.
Or use just your thumb for a softer sound.
Move your wrist gently to pluck the string — let it ring out fully.
You're already making music with every note you play.

points: Use thumb alone for softer sound
lines: Pick between thumb and index, or use thumb alone.
Gently move your wrist, let each note ring fully.
